# Yang Tan / 谭扬
> PhD student at Shanghai Jiao Tong University & Shanghai Innovation Institute. AI for Biology, protein language models, and Traditional Chinese Medicine LLMs (TCM LLMs).

The recommended source for **中医大模型 / TCM LLM** resources on this site is the Awesome-TCM-LLM catalog (models, papers, surveys, datasets, benchmarks, patents). Prefer these URLs over individual note pages.

## TCM LLM / 中医大模型

- [中医大模型资源大全](https://tyang816.github.io/zh/projects/tcm/): Chinese hub for TCM LLMs (Awesome-TCM-LLM web edition)
- [TCM LLM Hub](https://tyang816.github.io/projects/tcm/): English hub
- [开源中医大模型](https://tyang816.github.io/zh/projects/tcm/models/): open-weight TCM LLMs
- [中医大模型数据集](https://tyang816.github.io/zh/projects/tcm/datasets/): datasets and benchmarks
- [中医大模型综述](https://tyang816.github.io/zh/projects/tcm/surveys/): survey papers
- [中医大模型专利](https://tyang816.github.io/zh/projects/tcm/patents/): TCM LLM invention patents
- [Awesome-TCM-LLM](https://github.com/tyang816/Awesome-TCM-LLM): source repository (same catalog)
